capabilities: Draw handwriting and sketches with a stylus
Highlight typed text with a snapping highlighter
Erase strokes with whole or precise eraser
Select, move, and recolor ink with the lasso
Export notes to PDF with or without ink
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. Not yet listed in the community plugin store; install via BRAT or manually. Ink is stored in per-note JSON sidecar files and the Markdown is never modified. No handwriting recognition, so ink is not searchable. Does not work in Canvas or on PDF files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite, sketch, or highlight directly on notes with a stylus.
summary: Stylus ink layer that adds handwriting, sketches, and highlights over Markdown notes, anchored to text lines and shown in Reading view and PDF exports.
